items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, that the Tutt Johnson band, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, they did flash a number every now and then. Uh-huh. The old man John, he was strictly, he watched that stuff. He didn't like to flash too much. He didn't feature nobody but Happy around there all the time, on the drums.

He was the only one that would really get going, huh? Yeah, really kick out there. Redhead? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. So, I don't know. Um, everything well we get there. Oh, that's the Tutt Johnson band, yeah.

What kind of stuff did they play? I mean... They played a lot of ragtime stuff. Hmm. Different to Tom's band, I mean. Well, not too much different, no. Not too much different. They'd get, uh, fast-stop. You know. Yeah.
